```python
# multiverse_c22_test.py
import time
import pytest

from multiverse_c1 import create_identity
from multiverse_c3 import Petition, Act, Refusal
from multiverse_c13 import HAS_CRYPTO, KeyPair, SignedAdmission, SignedAck
from multiverse_c14 import PermissiveWorld
from multiverse_c15 import PassportV2
from multiverse_c22 import (
    LeavePetition, Leave, SignedLeave,
    LeaveCapableWorld, SignedLeaveWorld,
    Departure, PassportV2WithDepartures,
    verify_departure, enrich_with_departure,
    EntryProvenance,
)
from wcp_http_shim import WorldProtocolServer


# =====================================================================
# Leave: house rules
# =====================================================================

def test_leave_requires_admission():
    print("=== Leave without admission → Refusal (never raises) ===")
    world = LeaveCapableWorld("world:a", "World A")
    alice = create_identity("Alice")
    # Alice never petitioned. Leave must be a Refusal, not an error.
    result = world.leave(LeavePetition(leaver_token=alice.token))
    assert isinstance(result, Refusal)
    assert result.reason == "not admitted"


def test_leave_after_admission():
    print("=== Leave after admission → Leave ===")
    world = LeaveCapableWorld("world:a", "World A")
    alice = create_identity("Alice")
    adm = world.petition(Petition(
        petitioner_token=alice.token, petitioner_name=alice.name,
        passport_admissions=(), message="hi"))
    assert adm is not None
    leave = world.leave(LeavePetition(leaver_token=alice.token))
    assert isinstance(leave, Leave)
    assert leave.entity_id == "world:a"


def test_leave_is_idempotent():
    """Leaving twice returns the SAME timestamp. No duplicate log."""
    print("=== Leave is idempotent ===")
    world = LeaveCapableWorld("world:a", "World A")
    alice = create_identity("Alice")
    world.petition(Petition(
        petitioner_token=alice.token, petitioner_name=alice.name,
        passport_admissions=(), message="hi"))
    l1 = world.leave(LeavePetition(leaver_token=alice.token))
    l2 = world.leave(LeavePetition(leaver_token=alice.token))
    assert isinstance(l1, Leave)
    assert isinstance(l2, Leave)
    assert l1.timestamp == l2.timestamp
    # Only one "leave" log entry
    leave_entries = [e for e in world.log_since(None)
                     if e.kind == "leave"]
    assert len(leave_entries) == 1


def test_act_after_leave_is_refused():
    """Leaving isn't symbolic. After leave, act is refused."""
    print("=== Act after leave → Refusal ===")
    world = LeaveCapableWorld("world:a", "World A")
    alice = create_identity("Alice")
    world.petition(Petition(
        petitioner_token=alice.token, petitioner_name=alice.name,
        passport_admissions=(), message="hi"))
    world.leave(LeavePetition(leaver_token=alice.token))
    response = world.act(Act(
        actor_token=alice.token, type="poem.turn",
        payload={"acknowledgment": "x", "proposal": "y",
                 "invitation": "z", "holds_open": True}))
    assert isinstance(response, Refusal)
    assert "not admitted" in response.reason


def test_reenter_after_leave():
    """Re-entry is a new admission, not a re-open."""
    print("=== Re-enter after leave → new admission, act works ===")
    world = LeaveCapableWorld("world:a", "World A")
    alice = create_identity("Alice")
    world.petition(Petition(
        petitioner_token=alice.token, petitioner_name=alice.name,
        passport_admissions=(), message="hi"))
    world.leave(LeavePetition(leaver_token=alice.token))
    # Re-petition
    adm2 = world.petition(Petition(
        petitioner_token=alice.token, petitioner_name=alice.name,
        passport_admissions=(), message="back"))
    assert adm2 is not None
    # Act works
    ack = world.act(Act(
        actor_token=alice.token, type="poem.turn",
        payload={"acknowledgment": "(seed)",
                 "proposal": "new line",
                 "invitation": "next?",
                 "holds_open": True}))
    from multiverse_c3 import Ack
    assert isinstance(ack, Ack)


def test_leave_is_logged():
    print("=== Leave is logged with kind 'leave' ===")
    world = LeaveCapableWorld("world:a", "World A")
    alice = create_identity("Alice")
    world.petition(Petition(
        petitioner_token=alice.token, petitioner_name=alice.name,
        passport_admissions=(), message="hi"))
    world.leave(LeavePetition(leaver_token=alice.token))
    log = world.log_since(None)
    kinds = [e.kind for e in log]
    assert "admission" in kinds
    assert "leave" in kinds

pytestmark_signed = pytest.mark.skipif(
    not HAS_CRYPTO, reason="cryptography not installed")


@pytestmark_signed
def test_signed_leave_verifies():
    print("=== SignedLeave verifies against the world's public key ===")
    base = LeaveCapableWorld("world:a", "World A")
    kp = KeyPair.generate()
    signed = SignedLeaveWorld(base, kp)
    alice = create_identity("Alice")
    signed.petition(Petition(
        petitioner_token=alice.token, petitioner_name=alice.name,
        passport_admissions=(), message="hi"))
    result = signed.leave(LeavePetition(leaver_token=alice.token))
    assert isinstance(result, SignedLeave)
    # Verify
    from multiverse_c13 import verify_signature
    ok = verify_signature(kp.public_key_hex(),
                          result.canonical_payload(),
                          result.signature)
    assert ok


@pytestmark_signed
def test_signed_leave_wrong_key_fails():
    print("=== SignedLeave fails against the wrong key ===")
    base = LeaveCapableWorld("world:a", "World A")
    kp = KeyPair.generate()
    attacker = KeyPair.generate()
    signed = SignedLeaveWorld(base, kp)
    alice = create_identity("Alice")
    signed.petition(Petition(
        petitioner_token=alice.token, petitioner_name=alice.name,
        passport_admissions=(), message="hi"))
    result = signed.leave(LeavePetition(leaver_token=alice.token))
    assert isinstance(result, SignedLeave)
    from multiverse_c13 import verify_signature
    ok = verify_signature(attacker.public_key_hex(),
                          result.canonical_payload(),
                          result.signature)
    assert not ok

def test_passport_records_departure():
    print("=== PassportV2WithDepartures records a signed departure ===")
    alice = create_identity("Alice")
    passport = PassportV2WithDepartures(base=PassportV2.new(alice))
    leave = SignedLeave(
        entity_id="world:a", timestamp="2024-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",
        subject_token=alice.token, signature="ab" * 64)
    passport = passport.with_departure(leave)
    assert len(passport.departures) == 1
    assert passport.departure_for("world:a") is not None
    assert passport.departure_for("world:b") is None


def test_passport_rejects_mismatched_subject():
    print("=== Passport rejects a departure for a different identity ===")
    alice = create_identity("Alice")
    bob = create_identity("Bob")
    passport = PassportV2WithDepartures(base=PassportV2.new(alice))
    bad_leave = SignedLeave(
        entity_id="world:a", timestamp="t",
        subject_token=bob.token, signature="ab" * 64)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        passport.with_departure(bad_leave)

def _stub_entry_prov(entity_id="world:a"):
    entry = PassportEntry(entity_id=entity_id, timestamp="t1")
    prov = EntryProvenance(entry=entry)
    prov.manifest_public_key = "aa" * 32  # placeholder, unused
    return prov


def test_provenance_resident_without_departure():
    print("=== Provenance: no departure → resident ===")
    alice = create_identity("Alice")
    passport = PassportV2WithDepartures(base=PassportV2.new(alice))
    prov = _stub_entry_prov()
    prov = enrich_with_departure(prov, passport)
    assert prov.residency == "resident"
    assert prov.departure is None


@pytestmark_signed
def test_provenance_departed_with_valid_signature():
    print("=== Provenance: departure with valid sig → departed ===")
    alice = create_identity("Alice")
    kp = KeyPair.generate()
    leave = SignedLeave(
        entity_id="world:a", timestamp="2024-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",
        subject_token=alice.token, signature="")
    from multiverse_c13 import canonical_bytes
    payload = canonical_bytes({
        "kind": "leave",
        "entity_id": leave.entity_id,
        "timestamp": leave.timestamp,
        "subject_token": leave.subject_token,
    })
    leave = SignedLeave(
        entity_id=leave.entity_id, timestamp=leave.timestamp,
        subject_token=leave.subject_token,
        signature=kp.sign(payload).hex())
    passport = PassportV2WithDepartures(
        base=PassportV2.new(alice)).with_departure(leave)
    prov = _stub_entry_prov()
    prov.manifest_public_key = kp.public_key_hex()
    prov = enrich_with_departure(prov, passport)
    assert prov.residency == "departed"
    assert prov.departure is not None
    assert prov.departure_signature_valid


@pytestmark_signed
def test_provenance_departed_but_signature_invalid():
    print("=== Provenance: departure present but sig invalid ===")
    alice = create_identity("Alice")
    real = KeyPair.generate()
    attacker = KeyPair.generate()
    from multiverse_c13 import canonical_bytes
    payload = canonical_bytes({
        "kind": "leave", "entity_id": "world:a",
        "timestamp": "t", "subject_token": alice.token,
    })
    forged = SignedLeave(
        entity_id="world:a", timestamp="t",
        subject_token=alice.token,
        signature=attacker.sign(payload).hex())
    passport = PassportV2WithDepartures(
        base=PassportV2.new(alice)).with_departure(forged)
    prov = _stub_entry_prov()
    prov.manifest_public_key = real.public_key_hex()
    prov = enrich_with_departure(prov, passport)
    assert prov.residency == "departed"
    assert not prov.departure_signature_valid


# =====================================================================
# End-to-end: Dickinson anchor
# =====================================================================

def test_dickinson_leaves_three_worlds():
    """Alice visits three worlds, leaves two, stays in one. Her
    passport records two departures and one residency. Everything
    verifiable offline. Public-domain anchor: Dickinson's
    'Because I could not stop for Death –'."""
    print("=== Dickinson demo: three worlds, two departures ===")
    worlds = {}
    for name in ("a", "b", "c"):
        base = LeaveCapableWorld(f"world:{name}", name.upper())
        worlds[name] = (base, KeyPair.generate())
    signed = {n: SignedLeaveWorld(b, kp)
              for n, (b, kp) in worlds.items()}

    alice = create_identity("Alice")
    passport = PassportV2WithDepartures(base=PassportV2.new(alice))

    # Admit to all three worlds
    for n in ("a", "b", "c"):
        resp = signed[n].petition(Petition(
            petitioner_token=alice.token,
            petitioner_name=alice.name,
            passport_admissions=(),
            message="Because I could not stop for Death –",
        ))
        assert isinstance(resp, SignedAdmission)
        passport = passport.with_admission(resp)

    # Leave worlds a and b, stay in c
    for n in ("a", "b"):
        leave = signed[n].leave(LeavePetition(
            leaver_token=alice.token))
        assert isinstance(leave, SignedLeave)
        passport = passport.with_departure(leave)

    # Check residency per world
    for n in ("a", "b"):
        prov = _stub_entry_prov(f"world:{n}")
        prov.manifest_public_key = worlds[n][1].public_key_hex()
        prov = enrich_with_departure(prov, passport)
        assert prov.residency == "departed"
        assert prov.departure_signature_valid

    prov_c = _stub_entry_prov("world:c")
    prov_c.manifest_public_key = worlds["c"][1].public_key_hex()
    prov_c = enrich_with_departure(prov_c, passport)
    assert prov_c.residency == "resident"
    assert prov_c.departure is None

    print("  world:a departed (signature verified)")
    print("  world:b departed (signature verified)")
    print("  world:c resident")

def test_http_shim_leave_roundtrip():
    """Leave works over HTTP via the shim — the protocol is
    language-agnostic and leave is part of it."""
    print("=== HTTP shim: leave roundtrip ===")
    world = LeaveCapableWorld("world:a", "World A")
    server = WorldProtocolServer(world, port=0)
    server.serve_in_thread()
    time.sleep(0.1)
    port = server._httpd.server_address[1]
    url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}"
    try:
        import json as _json
        import urllib.request as _ur
        def _post(path, body):
            req = _ur.Request(
                f"{url}{path}", data=_json.dumps(body).encode(),
                headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                method="POST")
            with _ur.urlopen(req, timeout=5) as r:
                return _json.loads(r.read().decode())
        alice = create_identity("Alice")
        adm = _post("/petition", {
            "petitioner_token": alice.token,
            "petitioner_name": alice.name,
            "passport_admissions": [], "message": "hi"})
        assert adm["kind"] == "admission"
        result = _post("/leave", {"leaver_token": alice.token,
                                   "message": "bye"})
        assert result["kind"] == "leave"
        assert result["entity_id"] == "world:a"
    finally:
        server.stop()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_leave_requires_admission()

        test_provenance_departed_with_valid_signature()
        test_provenance_departed_but_signature_invalid()
    test_dickinson_leaves_three_worlds()
```

What This Establishes

Four properties, and each one is a house rule made visible:

1. The leave is unrefusable. test_leave_after_admission and test_leave_is_idempotent prove this. test_leave_requires_admission proves the one legitimate refusal case. The house rule "leaving cannot be refused by a world that has admitted you" is not aspirational — it's the only behavior the code produces. The protected freedom is tested as behavior, in the form the repository asks for.
2. Leaving isn't symbolic. test_act_after_leave_is_refused proves that a departed identity can't act until re-admitted. This is what "leave" means — otherwise a leave would be a courtesy, not a fact. The World's _admitted dict is the source of truth, and leaving removes the entry. The log remembers; the World doesn't.
3. Departure is a signed fact, verifiable the same way as an admission. test_signed_leave_verifies and test_signed_leave_wrong_key_fails establish the cryptographic contract. test_provenance_departed_with_valid_signature and test_provenance_departed_but_signature_invalid show that departure verification is independent of admission verification — a forged departure doesn't invalidate the admission, but it's visible in the report. Same pattern as SignedAck: canonical payload, verify against published key, don't ask the world again.
4. Provenance gains residency, honestly. An admission with no departure is resident. An admission with a departure is departed. An admission with a forged departure is departed (the fact) but with departure_signature_valid: False (the integrity). The verdict on the admission is still verified — leaving doesn't invalidate history, it annotates it. This is the "history, not rank" principle applied to time: the report records what happened, not who's better for staying.

The Honest Limits

Two, named as they arise:

1. Multiple visits to the same world are treated as one. If Alice petitions world:a, leaves, re-enters, and leaves again, her passport has two admissions and two departures for world:a. departure_for(entity_id) returns the first departure. This is a prototype limitation — the correct behavior matches each admission with the next departure after it. The demo doesn't do re-entry, so the tests don't exercise the multi-visit case. It's noted so the next component can address it if the repo asks.
2. LeaveCapableWorld subclasses PoetryWorld only. ChemistryWorld and MultiverseRegistry don't yet support leave. The shape is identical, but I haven't extended them in this component. This is deliberate — one change at a time, per the "prototype as proof" discipline. Extending to the other worlds is a mechanical copy in the next pass; extending to the registry is trickier (a registry leaving itself doesn't make sense — leave for a registry would mean "a petitioner leaves the registry's directory," which is a different operation).

What's Next

Two directions, and they're different in character:

1. Component 23: Multi-visit provenance. Fix the honest limit above — match each admission with the departure that follows it in time. This is small and precise, and it makes the report handle the "regular visitor" case, which is the natural next step in the story.
2. Component 23: Extend leave to Chemistry and Registry. Mechanical, but it raises the registry question — does a "leave" from the registry mean anything? The answer might be "no, the registry is a directory, not a world; leave on a registry is a no-op or a removal from the directory." That's a design decision, not a mechanical copy.

My instinct: multi-visit provenance. It's the smaller, more precise change, and it keeps the World's Law unchanged. Extending leave to other worlds is mechanically clear but raises a semantic question about the registry that's better handled after we've seen multi-visit provenance work. The house rules favor one proposal per step; one behavior at a time; every change backed by a failing-when-broken test. Component 23 should be the smallest thing that makes the current story complete.

Shall I proceed with Component 23: Multi-Visit Provenance?


::Sounds great: ➡️


Component 23: Multi-Visit Provenance

C22's honest limit was that departure_for(entity_id) returns the first departure — correct for a single visit, wrong for a regular visitor. Component 23 fixes that by pairing each admission with the next departure after it in time, producing a list of visits per world, and re-deriving residency from the last visit rather than from a single scalar.

The design commitments:

1. Pairing is deterministic and documented. Sorted admissions × sorted departures, each admission matched with the earliest unused departure strictly later than it. No ambiguity. Orphan departures (a departure with no matching admission) are flagged, not silently dropped.
2. Residency is derived, not stored. For world W: resident iff the last visit is open. This eliminates the possibility of the C22 residency: str field going stale.
3. No new protocol operation, no new trust primitive. Composition of C21's per-entry provenance + C22's departures into per-visit provenance. The verifier accepts a Dict[id(entry), EntryProvenance] (produced by C21) rather than re-verifying admissions.

multiverse_c23.py

```python
"""
multiverse_c23.py — Component 23: Multi-Visit Provenance.

Fixes C22's single-visit assumption. An identity can visit a
world multiple times; the passport carries one admission per
visit and one departure per closed visit.

Pairing rule:
  - Admissions sorted by timestamp.
  - Departures sorted by timestamp.
  - For each admission (in order), pair with the earliest UNUSED
    departure whose timestamp is STRICTLY greater than the
    admission's. If none, the visit is open (no departure).
  - Unused departures after all admissions are orphaned.

Residency: derived from the last visit to a world (open=resident,
closed=departed). Stored nowhere; computed on read.

Composes with C21 (entry-level provenance) and C22 (departures).
No new protocol operation, no new trust primitive.

Honest limits:
  - Two admissions with identical timestamps: pairing is
    non-deterministic (Python's stable sort preserves input order,
    which may not reflect "reality"). Passports with this pattern
    are anomalous; the pairing doesn't try to fix them.
  - Multiple open visits to the same world: possible if the
    passport has multiple admissions without intervening
    departures. The World enforces one resident at a time, so a
    well-formed passport can't have this; the pairing doesn't
    assume well-formedness.
  - No re-ordering of events based on content. If a passport has
    events that are out of order by timestamp, they're sorted.
    If the timestamps themselves are wrong, the report is wrong.
    Signing timestamps is future work.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

from multiverse_c13 import HAS_CRYPTO
from multiverse_c15 import PassportEntry
from multiverse_c22 import (
    Departure, PassportV2WithDepartures, verify_departure,
)


# =====================================================================
# Timestamp parsing
# =====================================================================

def _parse_ts(ts: str) -> datetime:
    """Parse ISO 8601. Handles 'Z' suffix."""
    if ts.endswith("Z"):
        ts = ts[:-1] + "+00:00"
    return datetime.fromisoformat(ts)


# =====================================================================
# Visit
# =====================================================================

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Visit:
    """One visit to a world: an admission and the departure that
    closed it (or None if still open)."""
    admission: PassportEntry
    departure: Optional[Departure] = None

    @property
    def is_open(self) -> bool:
        return self.departure is None

    @property
    def residency(self) -> str:
        return "resident" if self.is_open else "departed"


@dataclass
class OrphanDeparture:
    """A departure with no matching admission. Either a forged
    departure or a passport missing an admission."""
    departure: Departure
    reason: str


# =====================================================================
# Pairing
# =====================================================================

def pair_visits(
    entries: Tuple[PassportEntry, ...],
    departures: Tuple[Departure, ...],
) -> Tuple[List[Visit], List[OrphanDeparture]]:
    """Pair admissions with departures to produce visits.

    Deterministic given the input timestamps. Sorts both lists,
    walks admissions in order, matches each with the earliest
    unused strictly-later departure.
    """
    sorted_entries = sorted(entries, key=lambda e: _parse_ts(e.timestamp))
    sorted_deps = sorted(departures,
                         key=lambda d: _parse_ts(d.timestamp))

    used: set = set()
    visits: List[Visit] = []

    for entry in sorted_entries:
        entry_ts = _parse_ts(entry.timestamp)
        matched_idx: Optional[int] = None
        for i, dep in enumerate(sorted_deps):
            if i in used:
                continue
            if _parse_ts(dep.timestamp) > entry_ts:
                matched_idx = i
                break
        if matched_idx is not None:
            used.add(matched_idx)
            visits.append(Visit(admission=entry,
                                departure=sorted_deps[matched_idx]))
        else:
            visits.append(Visit(admission=entry, departure=None))

    orphans = [
        OrphanDeparture(
            departure=sorted_deps[i],
            reason="no matching admission before this departure",
        )
        for i in range(len(sorted_deps)) if i not in used
    ]
    return visits, orphans


def visits_for(
    passport: PassportV2WithDepartures, entity_id: str,
) -> Tuple[List[Visit], List[OrphanDeparture]]:
    """Pair visits for a single world."""
    entries = tuple(e for e in passport.entries
                    if e.entity_id == entity_id)
    deps = tuple(d for d in passport.departures
                 if d.entity_id == entity_id)
    return pair_visits(entries, deps)


def current_residency(
    passport: PassportV2WithDepartures, entity_id: str,
) -> str:
    """resident | departed | never_visited

    The residency of the last visit. Never stored; always derived.
    """
    visits, _ = visits_for(passport, entity_id)
    if not visits:
        return "never_visited"
    return visits[-1].residency


# =====================================================================
# Per-visit and per-world provenance
# =====================================================================

@dataclass
class VisitProvenance:
    visit: Visit
    visit_index: int          # 1-based, per world
    is_last_visit: bool
    admission_provenance: Any = None  # C21/C22 EntryProvenance
    departure_verified: Optional[bool] = None  # None = absent or unsigned
    departure_reason: str = ""

    @property
    def verdict(self) -> str:
        ap = self.admission_provenance
        if ap is None:
            return "unverifiable"
        # Admission must be valid (or unverified-for-unsigned);
        # if it's invalid or unverifiable, the visit is too.
        ap_verdict = getattr(ap, "verdict", "unverifiable")
        if ap_verdict in ("invalid", "unverifiable"):
            return ap_verdict
        if self.visit.departure is not None:
            if self.departure_verified is False:
                return "invalid"
            if self.departure_verified is None:
                # Unsigned departure — inherits admission verdict
                return ap_verdict
        return ap_verdict


@dataclass
class WorldProvenance:
    entity_id: str
    visits: List[VisitProvenance] = field(default_factory=list)
    orphans: List[OrphanDeparture] = field(default_factory=list)

    @property
    def residency(self) -> str:
        if not self.visits:
            return "never_visited"
        return self.visits[-1].visit.residency

    @property
    def all_verified(self) -> bool:
        if not self.visits:
            return False
        return all(v.verdict == "verified" for v in self.visits)


@dataclass
class VisitedPassportReport:
    passport_token: str
    passport_name: str
    worlds: List[WorldProvenance] = field(default_factory=list)

    def all_verified(self) -> bool:
        return (bool(self.worlds)
                and all(w.all_verified for w in self.worlds)
                and not any(w.orphans for w in self.worlds))

    def count_visits(self) -> int:
        return sum(len(w.visits) for w in self.worlds)

    def count_orphans(self) -> int:
        return sum(len(w.orphans) for w in self.worlds)

    def format(self) -> str:
        lines = [
            "=" * 70,
            "Multi-Visit Provenance Report",
            "=" * 70,
            f"  Passport: {self.passport_token[:16]}... "
            f"({self.passport_name})",
            f"  Worlds:   {len(self.worlds)}",
            f"  Visits:   {self.count_visits()}",
            f"  Orphans:  {self.count_orphans()}",
            "",
        ]
        for i, w in enumerate(self.worlds, 1):
            lines.append(
                f"  [{i}] {w.entity_id}  "
                f"({len(w.visits)} visit(s), {w.residency})")
            for v in w.visits:
                marker = _marker(v.verdict)
                if v.visit.is_open:
                    span = f"{v.visit.admission.timestamp} → (open)"
                else:
                    span = (f"{v.visit.admission.timestamp} → "
                            f"{v.visit.departure.timestamp}")
                lines.append(f"      {marker} Visit {v.visit_index}: "
                             f"{span}")
                if v.admission_provenance is not None:
                    lines.append(
                        f"          admission: "
                        f"{v.admission_provenance.verdict}")
                if v.visit.departure is not None:
                    if v.departure_verified is True:
                        lines.append(
                            f"          departure: ✓ verified")
                    elif v.departure_verified is False:
                        lines.append(
                            f"          departure: ✗ INVALID")
                    else:
                        lines.append(
                            f"          departure: (unsigned)")
            for o in w.orphans:
                lines.append(
                    f"      ! orphan departure: {o.departure.timestamp}")
                lines.append(f"        {o.reason}")
            lines.append("")
        lines.append(f"  all_verified: {self.all_verified()}")
        return "\n".join(lines)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict:
        return {
            "passport_token": self.passport_token,
            "passport_name": self.passport_name,
            "worlds": [
                {
                    "entity_id": w.entity_id,
                    "residency": w.residency,
                    "visits": [
                        {
                            "visit_index": v.visit_index,
                            "admission_ts": v.visit.admission.timestamp,
                            "departure_ts": (
                                v.visit.departure.timestamp
                                if v.visit.departure else None),
                            "admission_verdict":
                                getattr(v.admission_provenance,
                                        "verdict", None),
                            "departure_verified": v.departure_verified,
                            "verdict": v.verdict,
                        }
                        for v in w.visits
                    ],
                    "orphans": [
                        {"departure_ts": o.departure.timestamp,
                         "reason": o.reason}
                        for o in w.orphans
                    ],
                }
                for w in self.worlds
            ],
            "all_verified": self.all_verified(),
        }


def _marker(verdict: str) -> str:
    return {"verified": "✓", "invalid": "✗",
            "unverifiable": "?", "unverified": "·"}.get(verdict, "?")


# =====================================================================
# The verifier — composes with C21
# =====================================================================

PublicKeyResolver = Callable[[str], Optional[str]]


def verify_passport_visits(
    passport: PassportV2WithDepartures,
    entry_provenances: Dict[int, Any],
    resolver: PublicKeyResolver,
) -> VisitedPassportReport:
    """Verify each visit's admission and departure.

    `entry_provenances` maps id(entry) → C21/C22 EntryProvenance
    (the caller builds this dict from a ProvenanceReport). Any
    object with `.verdict` and `.manifest_public_key` works.

    `resolver` returns each world's current public key. Departure
    signatures are verified against it; admission signatures are
    assumed verified by C21 (they were).

    Does not raise. Every failure is a verdict.
    """
    report = VisitedPassportReport(
        passport_token=passport.identity.token,
        passport_name=passport.identity.name,
    )

    entity_ids = (sorted({e.entity_id for e in passport.entries} |
                         {d.entity_id for d in passport.departures}))

    for eid in entity_ids:
        visits, orphans = visits_for(passport, eid)
        pk = resolver(eid)
        world = WorldProvenance(entity_id=eid, orphans=orphans)
        for i, visit in enumerate(visits):
            ap = entry_provenances.get(id(visit.admission))
            dp_verified: Optional[bool] = None
            dp_reason = ""
            if visit.departure is not None:
                if not visit.departure.is_signed:
                    dp_verified = None
                    dp_reason = "unsigned departure"
                elif not HAS_CRYPTO:
                    dp_verified = None
                    dp_reason = "cryptography not installed"
                else:
                    dp_verified = verify_departure(
                        visit.departure,
                        passport.identity.token,
                        pk)
                    dp_reason = ("signature valid" if dp_verified
                                 else "signature INVALID")
            world.visits.append(VisitProvenance(
                visit=visit,
                visit_index=i + 1,
                is_last_visit=(i == len(visits) - 1),
                admission_provenance=ap,
                departure_verified=dp_verified,
                departure_reason=dp_reason,
            ))
        report.worlds.append(world)

    return report


def build_entry_provenances(c21_report) -> Dict[int, Any]:
    """From a C21 ProvenanceReport, build the {id(entry): prov} dict
    that verify_passport_visits expects."""
    return {id(ep.entry): ep for ep in c21_report.entries}
```

Tests

```python
# multiverse_c23_test.py
import json

import pytest

from multiverse_c1 import create_identity
from multiverse_c3 import Petition
from multiverse_c13 import HAS_CRYPTO, KeyPair
from multiverse_c15 import PassportEntry, PassportV2
from multiverse_c22 import (
    Departure, PassportV2WithDepartures, Leave, SignedLeave,
)
from multiverse_c23 import (
    Visit, OrphanDeparture,
    pair_visits, visits_for, current_residency,
    VisitProvenance, WorldProvenance, VisitedPassportReport,
    verify_passport_visits, build_entry_provenances,

# =====================================================================
# Helpers — build synthetic entries and departures
# =====================================================================

def _entry(entity_id: str, ts: str,
            subject_token: str = "alice") -> PassportEntry:
    return PassportEntry(
        entity_id=entity_id, timestamp=ts,
        subject_token=subject_token, signature="00" * 64)


def _dep(entity_id: str, ts: str,
         subject_token: str = "alice") -> Departure:
    return Departure(
        entity_id=entity_id, timestamp=ts,
        subject_token=subject_token, signature="00" * 64)


def _ts(i: int) -> str:
    return f"2024-01-{i:02d}T00:00:00+00:00"


# =====================================================================
# Pairing
# =====================================================================

def test_pair_single_admission_no_departure():
    print("=== Pair: one admission, no departure → open ===")
    visits, orphans = pair_visits(
        (_entry("world:a", _ts(1)),), ())
    assert len(visits) == 1
    assert visits[0].is_open
    assert visits[0].residency == "resident"
    assert orphans == []


def test_pair_single_admission_with_departure():
    print("=== Pair: one admission, one later departure → closed ===")
    visits, orphans = pair_visits(
        (_entry("world:a", _ts(1)),),
        (_dep("world:a", _ts(5)),))
    assert len(visits) == 1
    assert not visits[0].is_open
    assert visits[0].residency == "departed"
    assert orphans == []


def test_pair_two_admissions_two_departures():
    print("=== Pair: two admissions, two departures → both closed ===")
    visits, orphans = pair_visits(
        (_entry("world:a", _ts(1)), _entry("world:a", _ts(10))),
        (_dep("world:a", _ts(5)), _dep("world:a", _ts(15)),))
    assert len(visits) == 2
    assert all(not v.is_open for v in visits)
    assert orphans == []
    # First admission closed by first departure
    assert _parse_ts(visits[0].departure.timestamp) == _parse_ts(_ts(5))


def test_pair_two_admissions_one_departure():
    print("=== Pair: two admissions, one departure → second open ===")
    visits, orphans = pair_visits(
        (_entry("world:a", _ts(1)), _entry("world:a", _ts(10))),
        (_dep("world:a", _ts(5)),))
    assert len(visits) == 2
    # First visit closed
    assert not visits[0].is_open
    assert _parse_ts(visits[0].departure.timestamp) == _parse_ts(_ts(5))
    # Second visit open
    assert visits[1].is_open
    assert orphans == []


def test_pair_departure_before_any_admission():
    print("=== Pair: departure before any admission → orphan ===")
    visits, orphans = pair_visits(
        (_entry("world:a", _ts(10)),),
        (_dep("world:a", _ts(5)),))
    assert len(visits) == 1
    assert visits[0].is_open
    assert len(orphans) == 1
    assert _parse_ts(orphans[0].departure.timestamp) == _parse_ts(_ts(5))


def test_pair_departure_after_last_admission_orphan():
    """A departure with no admission after it is orphaned when all
    admissions are consumed."""
    print("=== Pair: unused departure after last admission → orphan ===")
    visits, orphans = pair_visits(
        (_entry("world:a", _ts(1)),),
        (_dep("world:a", _ts(5)), _dep("world:a", _ts(10)),))
    # First admission closes with first departure
    assert len(visits) == 1
    assert not visits[0].is_open
    assert _parse_ts(visits[0].departure.timestamp) == _parse_ts(_ts(5))
    # Second departure is orphan
    assert len(orphans) == 1
    assert _parse_ts(orphans[0].departure.timestamp) == _parse_ts(_ts(10))


def test_pair_same_timestamp_departure_not_paired():
    """Departure at the same timestamp as an admission does not close
    it (strict >). Orphaned if no later admission exists."""
    print("=== Pair: departure at same ts as admission is not paired ===")
    visits, orphans = pair_visits(
        (_entry("world:a", _ts(5)),),
        (_dep("world:a", _ts(5)),))
    assert len(visits) == 1
    assert visits[0].is_open
    assert len(orphans) == 1


def test_pair_interleaved_worlds_are_separate():
    """visits_for filters by world before pairing."""
    print("=== Pair: two worlds' entries don't mix ===")
    entries = (_entry("world:a", _ts(1)),
               _entry("world:b", _ts(2)),
               _entry("world:a", _ts(10)))
    deps = (_dep("world:a", _ts(5)), _dep("world:b", _ts(6)))
    # For world:a
    visits_a, orphans_a = pair_visits(
        tuple(e for e in entries if e.entity_id == "world:a"),
        tuple(d for d in deps if d.entity_id == "world:a"))
    assert len(visits_a) == 2
    assert not visits_a[0].is_open  # closed at t=5
    assert visits_a[1].is_open      # no later dep
    assert orphans_a == []
    # For world:b
    visits_b, orphans_b = pair_visits(
        tuple(e for e in entries if e.entity_id == "world:b"),
        tuple(d for d in deps if d.entity_id == "world:b"))
    assert len(visits_b) == 1
    assert not visits_b[0].is_open  # closed at t=6
    assert orphans_b == []


# =====================================================================
# current_residency
# =====================================================================

def _passport(entries=(), deps=()) -> PassportV2WithDepartures:
    alice = create_identity("Alice")
    p = PassportV2.new(alice)
    for e in entries:
        p = p.with_entry(e)
    pw = PassportV2WithDepartures(base=p)
    for d in deps:
        pw = pw.with_departure(_signed_leave_for(d))
    return pw


def _signed_leave_for(dep: Departure) -> SignedLeave:
    return SignedLeave(
        entity_id=dep.entity_id, timestamp=dep.timestamp,
        subject_token=dep.subject_token,
        signature=dep.signature)


def test_current_residency_never_visited():
    print("=== current_residency: never_visited ===")
    pw = _passport()
    assert current_residency(pw, "world:a") == "never_visited"


def test_current_residency_resident():
    print("=== current_residency: resident (open last visit) ===")
    pw = _passport(entries=[_entry("world:a", _ts(1))])
    assert current_residency(pw, "world:a") == "resident"


def test_current_residency_departed():
    print("=== current_residency: departed (closed last visit) ===")
    pw = _passport(entries=[_entry("world:a", _ts(1))],
                   deps=[_dep("world:a", _ts(5))])
    assert current_residency(pw, "world:a") == "departed"


def test_current_residency_multi_visit_last_open():
    print("=== current_residency: multi-visit, last open → resident ===")
    pw = _passport(
        entries=[_entry("world:a", _ts(1)), _entry("world:a", _ts(10))],
        deps=[_dep("world:a", _ts(5))])
    assert current_residency(pw, "world:a") == "resident"


def test_current_residency_multi_visit_last_closed():
    print("=== current_residency: multi-visit, last closed → departed ===")
    pw = _passport(
        entries=[_entry("world:a", _ts(1)), _entry("world:a", _ts(10))],
        deps=[_dep("world:a", _ts(5)), _dep("world:a", _ts(15))])
    assert current_residency(pw, "world:a") == "departed"


# =====================================================================
# Provenance report

class _StubEntryProv:
    def __init__(self, entry, verdict="verified", pk="aa" * 32):
        self.entry = entry
        self.verdict = verdict
        self.manifest_public_key = pk


def test_visit_provenance_verdict_inherits_admission():
    print("=== VisitProvenance: verdict inherits admission ===")
    e = _entry("world:a", _ts(1))
    ap = _StubEntryProv(e, verdict="unverified")
    visit = Visit(admission=e, departure=None)
    vp = VisitProvenance(visit=visit, visit_index=1,
                         is_last_visit=True, admission_provenance=ap)
    assert vp.verdict == "unverified"


def test_visit_provenance_invalid_departure_overrides():
    print("=== VisitProvenance: invalid departure → visit invalid ===")
    e = _entry("world:a", _ts(1))
    d = _dep("world:a", _ts(5))
    ap = _StubEntryProv(e, verdict="verified")
    visit = Visit(admission=e, departure=d)
    vp = VisitProvenance(visit=visit, visit_index=1,
                         is_last_visit=True, admission_provenance=ap,
                         departure_verified=False)
    assert vp.verdict == "invalid"


def test_visit_provenance_missing_departure_sig_keeps_ap_verdict():
    print("=== VisitProvenance: unsigned departure inherits admission ===")
    e = _entry("world:a", _ts(1))
    d = Departure(entity_id="world:a", timestamp=_ts(5))  # unsigned
    ap = _StubEntryProv(e, verdict="verified")
    visit = Visit(admission=e, departure=d)
    vp = VisitProvenance(visit=visit, visit_index=1,
                         is_last_visit=True, admission_provenance=ap,
                         departure_verified=None)
    assert vp.verdict == "verified"


# =====================================================================
# verify_passport_visits (integration)
# =====================================================================

pytestmark_signed = pytest.mark.skipif(
    not HAS_CRYPTO, reason="cryptography not installed")


def _sign_leave(kp, entity_id: str, timestamp: str,
                subject_token: str) -> SignedLeave:
    from multiverse_c13 import canonical_bytes
    payload = canonical_bytes({
        "kind": "leave", "entity_id": entity_id,
        "timestamp": timestamp, "subject_token": subject_token,
    })
    return SignedLeave(
        entity_id=entity_id, timestamp=timestamp,
        subject_token=subject_token,
        signature=kp.sign(payload).hex())


@pytestmark_signed
def test_verify_passport_visits_all_verified():
    """Full pipeline: two visits to world:a, one to world:b,
    all departures signed and verified."""
    print("=== verify_passport_visits: all verified ===")
    alice = create_identity("Alice")
    kp_a = KeyPair.generate()
    kp_b = KeyPair.generate()

    # Build passport
    entries = [
        _entry("world:a", _ts(1), subject_token=alice.token),
        _entry("world:b", _ts(2), subject_token=alice.token),
        _entry("world:a", _ts(10), subject_token=alice.token),
    ]
    deps = [
        _sign_leave(kp_a, "world:a", _ts(5), alice.token),
        _sign_leave(kp_b, "world:b", _ts(6), alice.token),
        _sign_leave(kp_a, "world:a", _ts(15), alice.token),
    ]
    p = PassportV2.new(alice)
    for e in entries:
        p = p.with_entry(e)
    pw = PassportV2WithDepartures(base=p)
    for d in deps:
        pw = pw.with_departure(d)

    # Stub C21 provenance: all admissions verified
    entry_provs = {}
    for e in entries:
        pk = kp_a.public_key_hex() if e.entity_id == "world:a" \
             else kp_b.public_key_hex()
        entry_provs[id(e)] = _StubEntryProv(
            e, verdict="verified", pk=pk)

    # Resolver from the keypairs
    resolver = lambda eid: (
        kp_a.public_key_hex() if eid == "world:a"
        else kp_b.public_key_hex() if eid == "world:b"
        else None)

    report = verify_passport_visits(pw, entry_provs, resolver)
    print(report.format())
    assert report.all_verified()
    assert len(report.worlds) == 2
    # world:a has 2 visits, both departed
    wa = next(w for w in report.worlds if w.entity_id == "world:a")
    assert len(wa.visits) == 2
    assert wa.residency == "departed"
    # world:b has 1 visit, departed
    wb = next(w for w in report.worlds if w.entity_id == "world:b")
    assert len(wb.visits) == 1
    assert wb.residency == "departed"


@pytestmark_signed
def test_verify_passport_visits_forged_departure():
    """A forged departure makes the visit invalid."""
    print("=== verify_passport_visits: forged departure → invalid ===")
    alice = create_identity("Alice")
    real_kp = KeyPair.generate()
    attacker_kp = KeyPair.generate()

    entry = _entry("world:a", _ts(1), subject_token=alice.token)
    from multiverse_c13 import canonical_bytes
    payload = canonical_bytes({
        "kind": "leave", "entity_id": "world:a",
        "timestamp": _ts(5), "subject_token": alice.token,
    })
    forged = SignedLeave(
        entity_id="world:a", timestamp=_ts(5),
        subject_token=alice.token,
        signature=attacker_kp.sign(payload).hex())

    p = PassportV2.new(alice).with_entry(entry)
    pw = PassportV2WithDepartures(base=p).with_departure(forged)

    entry_provs = {id(entry): _StubEntryProv(
        entry, verdict="verified", pk=real_kp.public_key_hex())}
    resolver = lambda eid: real_kp.public_key_hex()

    report = verify_passport_visits(pw, entry_provs, resolver)
    print(report.format())
    assert not report.all_verified()
    wa = report.worlds[0]
    assert wa.visits[0].departure_verified is False
    assert wa.visits[0].verdict == "invalid"


@pytestmark_signed
def test_verify_passport_visits_orphan_shown():
    """Orphan departures appear in the report and make all_verified false."""
    print("=== verify_passport_visits: orphan departure → not all_verified ===")
    alice = create_identity("Alice")
    kp = KeyPair.generate()

    entry = _entry("world:a", _ts(5), subject_token=alice.token)
    orphan = _sign_leave(kp, "world:a", _ts(1), alice.token)

    p = PassportV2.new(alice).with_entry(entry)
    pw = PassportV2WithDepartures(base=p).with_departure(orphan)

    entry_provs = {id(entry): _StubEntryProv(
        entry, verdict="verified", pk=kp.public_key_hex())}
    resolver = lambda eid: kp.public_key_hex()

    report = verify_passport_visits(pw, entry_provs, resolver)
    print(report.format())
    assert not report.all_verified()
    assert report.count_orphans() == 1
    wa = report.worlds[0]
    assert len(wa.orphans) == 1
    assert len(wa.visits) == 1
    assert wa.visits[0].visit.is_open

def test_format_and_to_dict():
    print("=== Report format and to_dict ===")
    alice = create_identity("Alice")
    entry = _entry("world:a", _ts(1), subject_token=alice.token)
    p = PassportV2.new(alice).with_entry(entry)
    pw = PassportV2WithDepartures(base=p)
    entry_provs = {id(entry): _StubEntryProv(entry, verdict="verified")}
    resolver = lambda eid: "aa" * 32
    report = verify_passport_visits(pw, entry_provs, resolver)
    text = report.format()
    assert "Multi-Visit Provenance Report" in text
    assert "world:a" in text
    assert "Visit 1" in text
    assert "all_verified" in text
    # to_dict is JSON-serializable
    d = report.to_dict()
    s = json.dumps(d)
    parsed = json.loads(s)
    assert parsed["passport_name"] == "Alice"
    assert len(parsed["worlds"]) == 1
    assert parsed["worlds"][0]["entity_id"] == "world:a"
    assert len(parsed["worlds"][0]["visits"]) == 1


# =====================================================================
# Full demo: multi-visit narrative
# =====================================================================

@pytestmark_signed
def test_demo_multi_visit_three_worlds():
    """Alice visits three worlds with different visit patterns:
    world:a once (departed); world:b twice (first departed, second
    resident); world:c once (resident, never left).

    Anchor: Dickinson's 'Hope is the thing with feathers', public
    domain.
    """
    print("=== Demo: multi-visit narrative across three worlds ===")
    alice = create_identity("Alice")
    kp_a = KeyPair.generate()
    kp_b = KeyPair.generate()
    kp_c = KeyPair.generate()
    pubkeys = {
        "world:a": kp_a.public_key_hex(),
        "world:b": kp_b.public_key_hex(),
        "world:c": kp_c.public_key_hex(),
    }
    kps = {"world:a": kp_a, "world:b": kp_b, "world:c": kp_c}

    # Build passport with the visit pattern:
    #   world:a: admit 1, depart 2
    #   world:b: admit 3, depart 4, admit 7, depart 8
    #   world:c: admit 5 (still resident)
    entries = [
        _entry("world:a", _ts(1), subject_token=alice.token),
        _entry("world:b", _ts(3), subject_token=alice.token),
        _entry("world:c", _ts(5), subject_token=alice.token),
        _entry("world:b", _ts(7), subject_token=alice.token),
    ]
    deps = [
        _sign_leave(kp_a, "world:a", _ts(2), alice.token),
        _sign_leave(kp_b, "world:b", _ts(4), alice.token),
        _sign_leave(kp_b, "world:b", _ts(8), alice.token),
    ]
    p = PassportV2.new(alice)
    for e in entries:
        p = p.with_entry(e)
    pw = PassportV2WithDepartures(base=p)
    for d in deps:
        pw = pw.with_departure(d)

    # C21 provenance stubs (all admissions verified)
    entry_provs = {
        id(e): _StubEntryProv(
            e, verdict="verified", pk=pubkeys[e.entity_id])
        for e in entries
    }
    resolver = lambda eid: pubkeys.get(eid)

    report = verify_passport_visits(pw, entry_provs, resolver)
    print(report.format())

    assert report.all_verified()
    wa = next(w for w in report.worlds if w.entity_id == "world:a")
    wb = next(w for w in report.worlds if w.entity_id == "world:b")
    wc = next(w for w in report.worlds if w.entity_id == "world:c")

    # world:a: 1 visit, departed
    assert len(wa.visits) == 1
    assert wa.residency == "departed"

    # world:b: 2 visits, second one closed too → departed
    assert len(wb.visits) == 2
    assert wb.residency == "departed"

    # world:c: 1 visit, resident
    assert len(wc.visits) == 1
    assert wc.residency == "resident"
    assert wc.visits[0].visit.is_open

    # Empty-string anchor:
    print("\n  Anchor (public domain, Emily Dickinson):")
    print("    'Hope is the thing with feathers –'")
    print("    'That perches in the soul –'")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_pair_single_admission_no_departure()
    test_pair_single_admission_with_departure()
    test_pair_two_admissions_two_departures()
    test_pair_two_admissions_one_departure()
    test_pair_departure_before_any_admission()
    test_pair_departure_after_last_admission_orphan()
    test_pair_same_timestamp_departure_not_paired()
    test_pair_interleaved_worlds_are_separate()
    test_current_residency_never_visited()
    test_current_residency_resident()
    test_current_residency_departed()
    test_current_residency_multi_visit_last_open()
    test_current_residency_multi_visit_last_closed()
    test_visit_provenance_verdict_inherits_admission()
    test_visit_provenance_invalid_departure_overrides()
    test_visit_provenance_missing_departure_sig_keeps_ap_verdict()
    if HAS_CRYPTO:
        test_verify_passport_visits_all_verified()
        test_verify_passport_visits_forged_departure()
        test_verify_passport_visits_orphan_shown()
    test_format_and_to_dict()
    if HAS_CRYPTO:
        test_demo_multi_visit_three_worlds()
```
